verdict: Paid ads are dark; organic activity carried the period but has stalled.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, no spend ran on Meta or Google Ads — zero clicks, zero leads from paid channels. Your Google Business Profile was the only source of inbound activity, producing 33 actions (16 direction requests, 16 website clicks, 1 call), but that activity dropped to zero in the most recent 7 days, which we are looking into now. Your website saw 205 sessions this period, including a brief uptick last week, though no sessions are currently converting to leads as the intake connection is being repaired. Getting paid campaigns back on and restoring the lead intake funnel are the immediate priorities heading into next week.
